title: Add Instagram link and improve public discoverability

requirements.summary: Add clickable Instagram icon/link in the footer (and optionally header) that opens https://www.instagram.com/ptripathy1989?igsh=MTJ5bHl5YjJ5Y3VvMw== in a new tab, visible on all pages and styled consistently with the mystical/cosmic theme
acceptanceCriteria: An Instagram icon/button is visible in the footer on all pages
Clicking the Instagram icon opens https://www.instagram.com/ptripathy1989?igsh=MTJ5bHl5YjJ5Y3VvMw== in a new browser tab
The link is styled consistently with the existing mystical/cosmic theme

file_operations.description: Update the footer section to include an Instagram icon/link using an SVG Instagram icon. Add the link with href='https://www.instagram.com/ptripathy1989?igsh=MTJ5bHl5YjJ5Y3VvMw==' and target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'. Style it to match the existing cosmic gold theme using hover effects consistent with other interactive elements. Ensure the Instagram icon appears alongside any existing social links in the footer and is visible on all viewport sizes.

Optionally add an Instagram icon/link to the header navigation area (desktop and mobile menu). Use the same Instagram URL (https://www.instagram.com/ptripathy1989?igsh=MTJ5bHl5YjJ5Y3VvMw==) with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Style it consistently with existing header elements using the gold accent color on hover. Position it appropriately within the navigation layout so it doesn't interfere with existing nav links and CTAs.

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive SEO meta tags to frontend/index.html including descriptive title, meta description with services and ₹400 pricing, Open Graph tags, and robots meta tag to improve public discoverability on search engines
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes a <title> tag with a descriptive name
A <meta name='description'> tag is present with a relevant summary of services
Open Graph meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:type) are present
A <meta name='robots' content='index, follow'> tag is present
No existing functionality is broken by these additions

file_operations.description: Update the <head> section to include comprehensive SEO meta tags. Change the <title> to 'Omm Vedic Numerology – Tarot, Numerology, Vastu & Pronology Consultations'. Add a <meta name='description'> tag with content summarizing the services (Tarot, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology) and the ₹400 booking price. Add Open Graph meta tags: <meta property='og:title'>, <meta property='og:description'> (matching the description), and <meta property='og:type' content='website'>. Add <meta name='robots' content='index, follow'> to ensure search engines can crawl and index the site. Preserve all existing meta tags and ensure the viewport and charset tags remain intact.
